messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Billing: token-aggregation drift detected in prod-us-east-1. metric=token_count_delta drift_pct=8.3% window=15m • possible delayed commits or duplicate emits

incident-bot: sample_log: 
  2026-03-17T03:12:08Z WARN emitter: late-window commit id=agg-44 lag=118234
  2026-03-17T03:13:02Z ERROR billing: overage_flag emitted customer=acct_0x93 reason=token_delta_spike

ryan_oncall: Ack. taking on-call. Ana, can you triage ingestion/agg pipelines? I'll validate customer impact and escalate billing ops.

ana_sre: taking it. first glance shows kafka consumer lag on aggregator group `redwood-agg-prod`. running quick checks now.

mike_eng: I see the same in shadow_agg metrics — a burst of late emits between 03:10-03:18, looks correlated to a GC pause on agg-worker-7. snippet from logs:
```
[03:11:58] agg-worker-7: pause=12.8s GC young gen
[03:12:06] emitter: batch_commit timeout for shard=12
[03:12:35] agg-worker-7: resumed; reprocessing 124k messages
```

ana_sre: can you paste kafka-consumer-groups output? need lag per partition.

mike_eng: running: 
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group redwood-agg-prod
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage-events    0          4829183         4957390         128207
usage-events    1          4810021         4810120         99
... (rest omitted)
```

ana_sre: confirmed. partition 0 lag ~128k. likely the emitter retried or aggregator stalled causing late commits and then a flood reprocessing which inflated interim deltas. plan: 1) pause overage flagging, 2) restart agg-worker-7 (targeted), 3) start backfill/reconciliation job, 4) notify affected customers.

ryan_oncall: Customer-impact check: any live overage emails sent? jen_custsuccess?

jen_custsuccess: Two customers pinged support with billing emails (acct_0x93, acct_0xA2). I replied with an acknowledgement and said we're investigating; asked for logs/screenshots. Drafting proactive message now to let them know we may reverse erroneous charges. (sending) :envelope_with_arrow:

billing_ops: Pausing downstream overage notifications now — toggled suppression flag (ops-ui): `billing.overage_notifications=false` . Will hold until reconciliation completes. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy/rolling-restart started for service=agg-worker tag=2026.3.17-agg. Rolling restart of node agg-worker-7 queued.

mike_eng: restart completed for agg-worker-7. post-restart consumer lag trend: 128k -> 30k -> 4.1k over 7m. metric snapshot:
```
03:20 lag=128207
03:24 lag=30122
03:27 lag=4120
```

ana_sre: starting reconciliation/backfill run now. command: 
```
$ ./backfill_reconcile --topic usage-events --from-offset 4829000 --to-end --id reconcile-1765123490
```
Estimated time ~18m. Will monitor output and surface any divergent token counts.

jen_custsuccess: Sending update to affected customers: "We detected an internal billing processing delay that produced premature overage notifications. We are pausing notifications and will reconcile usage; if any charges were applied in error we will reverse them. ETA ~30m for reconciliation." (sending) :envelope_with_arrow:

billing_ops: running quick pre/post delta check after backfill. sample SQL: 
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_before FROM snapshot_2026_03_17 WHERE window='03:00-03:15' GROUP BY customer_id;
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_after FROM reconciled_snapshot WHERE window='03:00-03:15' GROUP BY customer_id;
```

mike_eng: preliminary reconciliation shows token_count for acct_0x93 drops from 1.2M -> 84k (clearly a transient spike). Looks like false positive.

ryan_oncall: Good. Next steps: keep overage notifications paused, finish backfill, prepare rollback of any charges, and create postmortem with root cause: agg-worker GC + insufficient consumer backpressure. I'll hand this to morning oncall (ana will own the backfill to completion). @ana_sre please add remediation checklist (tune GC, limit batch size, add consumer lag alert threshold).

ana_sre: will do. opening follow-up ticket: INF-1429 with action items and timeline.

ryan_oncall: Handing off to morning oncall @mira_oncall at 08:00 local. Summary: transient token-count inflation due to aggregator pause -> late reprocessing -> temporary overage flags. Suppressed notifications, restarted worker, running reconciliation, customers notified and will be refunded if charged. Closing pager for now — continue monitoring. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager resolved: check run: reconciliation job succeeded, suppression flag still active until accounting confirms refunds. Resolution note: targeted restart + backfill fixed counts.

jen_custsuccess: will follow up with affected customers after refunds processed.

ana_sre: leaving monitoring hooks for 24h and scheduling GC tuning rollout in next deploy.

ryan_oncall: Thanks team.
